data.title: 信浓 · 冬日暖桌的九尾包裹
data.description: 冬日居室内暖桌散发融融暖意，窗外轻雪纷飞。信浓穿着软糯开衫依偎在身旁，将九条巨大蓬松的雪白狐尾完全展开裹住你取暖，亲手喂你吃剥好的甜橘，满脸恬静。
data.location: cozy winter living room with kotatsu and soft snowfall outside window
data.action: 穿着软糯开衫依偎在身旁，将九条巨大蓬松的雪白狐尾完全展开裹住你取暖，亲手喂你吃剥好的甜橘
data.lighting: warm cozy domestic lamplight contrasting with cold outdoor snow
data.promptProse: Silver-haired Shinano sits beside the kotatsu in her pale wrap, nine fox tails draped around the dark-haired commander sitting at her left. His olive sweater and short hair emerge above the white fur. She offers him a peeled mandarin segment while snow collects beyond the window.
